caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair viewed at a slight angle, showing both the front and the right side of the chair. The chair has a curved backrest with an oval top rail, on which are painted two stylized birds facing each other in shades of yellow and brown. The armrests are curved and supported by turned wooden spindles. The seat appears to be made of interwoven cane or wicker in a yellowish-brown color. Decorative painted motifs are also visible on the front rail and the side rails beneath the seat, mostly in yellow and brown tones. The chair's wooden frame is rendered in a muted dark blue or grayish-blue, with areas that show signs of wear, revealing patches of a lighter color underneath. The legs are turned in a traditional style, and the chair sits on two curved rockers. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a light beige or off-white color.
title: Decorated Child's Rocking Chair
